Se estiver pesquisando um notebook, por exemplo, você pode perguntar sobre a duração da bateria ou o desempenho em jogos. Em uma aula, dá para pedir um resumo dos pontos principais ou uma explicação de um assunto específico. Você ainda pode juntar vídeos com documentos e páginas da web para conferir informações e entender melhor assuntos técnicos. titulo: Rare fossil discovery reveals new dinosaur species that specialized in eating fruit
resumo: Among the ravenous carnivores and lumbering herbivores that roamed the Cretaceous landscape, another kind of dinosaur was evolving that started to eat something else: the plants that began to flower and produce fruit. The discovery by paleontologists from Stony Brook University, Royal Ontario Museum (ROM) and the North Dakota Geological Survey reveals that a new species, Infernogallus jamesi—a type of small oviraptorosaur—had chewing muscles for mashing soft food, making it the first known dinosaur that specifically ate fruit.

titulo: Scientists discover metals that defy the deep freeze at -424°F

titulo: Treatment with norrin helps maintain healthy blood vessels and preserve vision in diabetic rats

The condition is caused by damage to the blood vessels in the retina, the light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye. At first, diabetic retinopathy might not cause any symptoms, or the problems might be mild. However, if the underlying diabetes remains poorly managed, it can lead to blindness.

titulo: Scientists discover a bacterial defense so strange they thought it was broken
resumo: Scientists have discovered a bizarre bacterial defense system that works almost completely backward from anything seen before. titulo: How We Could Have Backdoored Bash (Hacktron blog)
resumo: The Hacktron blog documents how the group was able to compromise the GNU Savannah forge and could have pushed malware into any of the projects hosted there. Using Hacktron, we found that an email address like `touch${IFS}/tmp/savane-rce-proof`@attacker.example gave any registered user code execution on its backend. From there, we made our account a superuser, impersonated Bash's maintainer, and confirmed we could add an SSH key with push access to the upstream Bash repository. An unpatched kernel gave us root access and access to a GNU backup server. We reported it to the FSF on May 11, 2026.

titulo: Usar o carro com motor frio pode dar problema em revisões?
resumo: Ligar o carro e sair imediatamente virou um hábito comum, já que os veículos modernos não exigem os procedimentos dos modelos antigos para funcionar. Mesmo assim, o motor frio merece atenção, principalmente quando o automóvel é usado diariamente em trajetos curtos. O motor a combustão precisa atingir uma faixa adequada de temperatura para trabalhar nas condições ideais. Embora os sistemas atuais acelerem esse processo, o uso frequente sem que o conjunto chegue à temperatura de funcionamento pode aumentar o desgaste de componentes internos e elevar o consumo de combustível. O problema é que esse tipo de utilização pode ser classificado como uso severo pelas fabricantes. Nesse cenário, o intervalo recomendado para as revisões pode cair pela metade , o que significa visitas mais frequentes à oficina e custos extras de manutenção. Por que rodar sempre com o motor frio prejudica o carro? Nos veículos modernos, o óleo lubrificante começa a circular poucos segundos após a partida . Ainda assim, o motor pode levar cerca de 20 minutos para alcançar a temperatura ideal , dependendo das condições de uso. The measure could generate an estimated €10 billion annually, with companies including Google, Meta, Netflix and potentially TikTok among those affected. However, the proposal still faces further parliamentary scrutiny, while government officials have raised concerns about its implementation, measurement requirements and potential impact on smaller providers.

titulo: Scientists discover a surprising brain benefit of eating peanuts every day
resumo: A surprising new study suggests that eating peanuts every day could help support brain health and memory in older adults. titulo: Heavy hydrogen in 3I/ATLAS's methane points to a frigid birthplace
resumo: The interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS carries a chemical clue to conditions in the planetary system of its origin, locked away long before it reached our sun. Its methane signature is unusually rich in heavy hydrogen, suggesting that the comet's frozen ingredients took shape in an intensely cold environment around another star—or in the cloud that preceded it.
